name: upsertDocumentType
body: mutation upsertDocumentType($id: ID!, $name: String) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentType(input: { id: $id, name: $name }) { created returning { id name } } } }

name: refDocumentTypeListGet
body: query refDocumentTypeListGet { searchDocumentType { elems { id name } count } }

name: upsertDocumentProcessSettings
body: mutation upsertDocumentProcessSettings($id: ID!, $documentType: ID!, $processId: String, $enabled: Boolean) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentProcessSettings(input: { id: $id, documentType: $documentType, processId: $processId, enabled: $enabled }) { created returning { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } } } }

name: searchDocumentProcessSettings
body: query searchDocumentProcessSettings($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String) { searchDocumentProcessSettings(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond) { elems { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } count } }

name: searchPdsContract
body: query searchPdsContract($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String, $sort: [_SortCriterionSpecification!]) { searchPdsContract(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond, sort: $sort) { elems { id documentId documentType { id name } contractDate contractNumber snils approvalStatus createdBy createdAt } count } }

name: createPdsContract
body: mutation createPdsContract($input: _CreatePdsContractInput!) { packet { createPdsContract(input: $input) { id documentId documentType { id name } contractDate contractNumber snils approvalStatus createdBy createdAt } } }

name: updatePdsContract
body: mutation updatePdsContract($input: _UpdatePdsContractInput!) { packet { updatePdsContract(input: $input) { id approvalStatus } } }

name: createAttachment
body: mutation createAttachment($input: _CreateAttachmentInput!) { packet { createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } } }

checkSelects.description: Only assigned operator can create attachments while document is in work

name: searchAttachment
body: query searchAttachment($cond: String) { searchAttachment(cond: $cond) { elems { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } count } }

name: replaceAttachmentVersion
body: mutation replaceAttachmentVersion($currentAttachmentId: ID!, $input: _CreateAttachmentInput!) { packet { updateAttachment(input: { id: $currentAttachmentId, current: false }) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId version current } createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } } }

checkSelects.description: Only current attachment version can be replaced
Only assigned operator can replace attachments while document is in work

name: deleteAttachment
body: mutation deleteAttachment($id: ID!, $documentId: String!) { packet { deleteAttachment(id: $id) } }

checkSelects.description: Only attachments of the requested document can be deleted
Only assigned operator can delete attachments while document is in work
